review_comments: Not part of your change, but just curious why the assert below has `tzi.BaseUtcOffset == ts || tzi.GetUtcOffset(DateTime.Now) == ts`. Why would `tzi.BaseUtcOffset == ts` not always be true?

`tzi.BaseUtcOffset` is the UTC offset of the zone when we are in the standard time. If the zone is in daylight saving time, the condition `tzi.BaseUtcOffset == ts` can be false. That is why we add the `tzi.GetUtcOffset(DateTime.Now) == ts` condition. We include the 2 conditions because sometimes the Windows update can delay on a machine during the period of the Standard<->daylight transition, and Windows display names are not updated yet.
Ah. Don't reset the PR for it but that might be worth a comment at point.
